Name: Zebedee
Role: Fisherman; Father of James and John
Summary: Zebedee was a Galilean fisherman and the father of the apostles James and John. He was mending nets with his sons when Jesus called them, and they left the boat and their father to follow Him.
KeyStory: Zebedee watched his sons walk away from the family boat to follow a travelling teacher.
RelatedPeople: James, Son of Zebedee; John the Apostle; Jesus
LifeLesson: A father's nets cannot hold sons God has called. Zebedee's loss was the church's gain.
